title: HB 2331 (107th General Assembly): As introduced, requires the coordinator of elections, in conjunction with the commissioner of safety, to equip a mobile unit or units to travel throughout the state to issue photo identifications to those meeting the requirements to obtain a photo identification free of charge to vote. - Amends TCA Section 2-11-202; Section 2-7-112 and Section 55-50-336.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) 2-11-202(c)(1) (Section 1)
(quote) the coordinator of elections, in coordination with the commissioner of safety, shall establish a mobile unit program to equip a mobile unit or units, as provided in subdivision (2), to issue photo identifications free of charge to those persons who meet the requirements of § 55-50-336 for the purpose of voting. The program shall require that such mobile unit or units, as necessary, become available for use no later than July 1, 2012.
(section) 2-11-202(c)(3)
(quote) The coordinator of elections shall publish on its website the times and locations when the mobile unit will be in a specific location and shall notify the county election commission of such dates and times.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) 2-11-202(c)(2): units travel to predetermined places and dates, focused on elderly, disabled and indigent residents of remote areas.
(other) Section 2: effective on becoming law.
(other) Caption lists amending 2-7-112 and 55-50-336 but the body text amends only 2-11-202.
(other) version: 511961-Draft (2012-01-10): mobile-unit free photo-ID program (slot b).
(other) version: 517053-Draft (2012-01-11): same words; only line breaks and spacing differ.
(other) note: Caption names Sections 2-7-112 and 55-50-336 but neither is amended in the saved text. Tie vote 4-4 on 2012-03-14. Slot b only.
